epa_range.note: Labels are EPA's own; they weren't mapped to the maker's trims.

adapter.note: 'Adapters will be included as standard equipment with MY2025 EX90, EX40 and EC40. For existing customers, adapters are available for purchase at your Volvo Cars retailer.'

charge_port.note: Volvo's NACS page lists EC40 among models that reach Superchargers via the 'NACS Fast Charging Adapter', which implies a CCS1 port.

supercharger_access.note: Volvo's NACS page, 'Which fully electric Volvo models can access the Tesla Supercharger Network?': 'The Volvo EX90, EX30, EX40, EC40, XC40 Recharge and C40 Recharge can access the network.'

cross_check.note: Tesla lists Volvo among manufacturers with access to NACS Superchargers; 'can be accessed through an adapter. The adapter has to be provided by your vehicle manufacturer.' Read through headless Edge (sources/tesla-supercharging-other-evs-rendered.html); curl gets HTTP 403.

us_status.note: Unclear. Volvo's US media home links a '/us/media/models/ec40/2027/' page (HTTP 503 when fetched). But volvocars.com/us/cars/ec40-electric/ returns 404, the consumer site's nav lists EX30 and EX40 but not EC40, and C/D's 2026 EC40 entry has no trims. Not on any of the six ranking lists.

epa_range.note: EPA 2026 EC40 Twin. The EC40's dimensions and trim list come from C/D's 2024 C40 Recharge, so the years don't match.

trims.note: C/D trim list for the 2024 C40 Recharge; no Volvo EC40 source (media page HTTP 503 again on 2026-09-19).

entries.note: C/D 2024 C40 Recharge review: 'a battery pack with 75.0-kWh of usable energy storage'. C/D's spec page lists '78 kWh Capacity'.
C/D: 'all C40 Recharge models are capable of 200-kW DC fast charging'. Its test sheet lists '150 or 200 kW'.
C/D: 'said to be capable of juicing the battery from 10 to 80 percent charge in just 28 mins'. Charger power not stated.

notes.text: Almost everything here is Car and Driver's data for the 2024 C40 Recharge, the EC40's earlier name. Volvo's own EC40 pages weren't reachable.
EPA range is the 2026 EC40 Twin; warranty is from Volvo's MY2026 fully-electric manual, which names the EC40.

Volvo's EC40 pages were retried on 2026-09-19 after chat's reply: volvocars.com/us/cars/ec40-electric/ is still a 404 (curl and headless Edge) and the US media site still returns 503. The record stays as it is.

No maker link: on 2026-09-19 volvocars.com/us/ and /us/cars/electric-cars/ link the EX30, EX40, EX60 and EX90 and no EC40. The EC40 survives there only in unused page strings that still describe it as the C40 Recharge.
